 Revenues for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 was INR 21,806 crores. EBITDA excluding

609 crores. PAT after minority interest and excluding fair value gain on the stake held by Dixon

 Margins during the quarter were impacted on expiration of mobile PLI 1 scheme along with

higher input cost through corresponding increasing in selling prices resulted in a lower reported

increased cost through pricing adjustments. 
 Our mobile business has remained resilient, sustaining volumes at broadly stable year-on-year 
levels, despite the challenging operating environment. Exports volumes for our anchor customer 
is expected to ramp up meaningfully from Q4, with further growth anticipated along with exports 
of feature phones and smartphones, exports of Transsion Group's brands from the next fiscal.

optical transceivers and advanced packaging capabilities to capture rapidly growing AI 
infrastructure, hyperscale data centers, telecom centers, and high-speeding computing 
technologies that can transmit increasingly large volumes of data with greater bandwidth.

first of the Indian companies to establish capabilities in these segments through strategic
